"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"ISIS has brought ancient butchery into the 21st century.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Bashar Assad, the dictator of Syria, has murdered hundreds of thousands of his own people and created millions of refugees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An American president has been unable to rally the world against Bashar Assad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our allies fear for their future in a region that is more dangerous than it was eight years ago.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
